limitations: Historical attempts retained neither HTTP status nor raw SDK messages; they cannot be retrospectively classified with certainty.
Four concurrent synthetic requests are a bounded burst, not a sustained throughput test or a reproduction of four whole workflows.
No server-side logs were available in this investigation.
Wire HTTP 200 alone does not establish complete SSE success; the workflow also passed its independent oracle.
Host token totals include repeated context and do not establish billed cost or all child-session usage.
